# Fork: Preferences ▸ AI Models (new complete language bs, #10290)

column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: Modeli su opcionalni i rade u potpunosti na ovom računaru. Preuzimanje dobavlja datoteku modela sa Hugging Face; slike i dokumenti se nikada ne otpremaju. Bez modela, Izaberi subjekat, Ukloni pozadinu i Ukloni subjekat koriste ugrađene metode bez AI.
